text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but I should not treat a gain by itself as a signal to sell; weigh future prospects and the portfolio as a whole.","I should review losing positions as carefully as winners, rather than letting the pain of realizing a loss keep me invested without a sound reason.","My account value rose while I made no trades, reinforcing that I can be patient and make deliberate decisions instead of reacting to short-term changes."]}
